mapper.select: SELECT B.BOOK_ID AS bookId, B.ISBN AS isbn, B.TITLE AS title, B.AUTHOR AS author, B.PUBLISHER AS publisher, B.PUBLISH_DATE AS publishDate, B.CATEGORY_CD AS categoryCd, C.CATEGORY_NM AS categoryNm, B.LOCATION AS location, B.LOAN_YN AS loanYn, B.REG_DATE AS regDate FROM TB_BOOK B LEFT JOIN TB_CATEGORY C ON B.CATEGORY_CD = C.CATEGORY_CD WHERE B.BOOK_ID = #{bookId}
SELECT CATEGORY_CD AS categoryCd, CATEGORY_NM AS categoryNm, UPPER_CATEGORY_CD AS upperCategoryCd FROM TB_CATEGORY ORDER BY CATEGORY_CD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BOOK ( BOOK_ID, ISBN, TITLE, AUTHOR, PUBLISHER, PUBLISH_DATE, CATEGORY_CD, LOCATION, LOAN_YN, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{bookId}, #{isbn}, #{title}, #{author}, #{publisher}, #{publishDate}, #{categoryCd}, #{location}, #{loanYn}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BOOK SET ISBN = #{isbn}, TITLE = #{title}, AUTHOR = #{author}, PUBLISHER = #{publisher}, PUBLISH_DATE = #{publishDate}, CATEGORY_CD = #{categoryCd}, LOCATION = #{location} WHERE BOOK_ID = #{bookId}
UPDATE TB_BOOK SET LOAN_YN = #{loanYn} WHERE BOOK_ID = #{bookId}
